title: ic10-lint.json
description: The config for ic10-lint and IC10 Bench's script checks: https://github.com/tasermonkey/ic10-bench/blob/main/packages/ic10-lint/REFERENCE.md#config

dir.description: The folder of scripts to check when you don't name any, from this file's folder. Default ic10.

overrides.description: By script path from this file's folder, with /. Each needs a reason.

reason.description: Why this script is an exception.

limits.description: Lets a script already over a limit stay that size, but not grow.

columns.description: Over the game's 90 characters a line of code.

bytes.description: Over the game's 4096 characters, counted as the game counts them.

rules.description: Severities for this script only, over the project's.

max-lines.description: No more than the game's 128 lines (comments and blank lines count). Default error.

max-columns.description: No line past the game's 90 characters (only a comment past it is a warning). Default error.

max-bytes.description: No more than the game's 4096 characters, counted as the game counts them. Default error.

validate.description: The script loads in the emulator. Default error.

batch-ops.description: Batch instructions use logic types their prefab has. Needs a device catalogue. Default error.

hash-name.description: HASH() of a number, or of a prefab the game doesn't have. Default error.

relative-branch-to-label.description: A br* branch or jr given a label, which it takes as an offset. Default warn.

absolute-jump-number.description: A jump to a line number rather than a label. Default warn.

unused.description: An alias, define or label nothing uses. Default warn.

register-flow.description: A register read before it's written, or written and never read. Default off.

idle.description: IC10 Bench only: run for 50 ticks against stand-in devices (every pin, every reference ID it writes, a housing with every logic type), the script doesn't halt or run out of lines. Default error.
